name: hud_ui_panel_get_font
description: HudUiPanel::GetFont returns the panel font handle.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40bea0 loads self->hFont from offset 0x154 and returns.
Native smoke zhud_panel_text_color_shadow_smoke sets the font handle through HudUiPanel::SetFontHandle and verifies HudUiPanel::GetFont returns the same handle.
